summary: A Yes vote authorizes $300 million in general obligation bonds, repaid by property taxes averaging about $22.14 per $100,000 of assessed value per year, to fund fire stations, emergency response facilities, parks and recreation facilities, other public infrastructure, and climate resiliency.

tax.text: A Yes vote would authorize up to $300 million in bonds and increase property taxes to fund emergency facilities, parks, and infrastructure upgrades.
tax.quote: Authorizes up to $300 million in general obligation bonds for emergency response facilities, parks, seismic and climate resilience upgrades, and replacing aging natural gas infrastructure.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the $300 million infrastructure bond, which would increase annual property taxes to fund city infrastructure and facilities.
tax.quote: The measure would increase annual property taxes by $44 for every $100,000 of a home’s assessed value.
